description: This file is the code-behind for the 'SetExam' page in an online examination system. It manages exam question setup, course selection based on semester, adding multiple-choice questions (MCQs) to the database, setting up exams for courses, and navigation between pages. It interacts directly with SQL Server database tables such as 'mcqQS' for questions and 'mcqCourseDetail' for exam details, and contains event handlers for UI controls.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: Partial class for the 'SetExam' page, derived from System.Web.UI.Page, managing exam setup functionalities.
